changes: The daily look back is now a journal: write freely about what you noticed, and read past entries in Progress.
A microphone button on every text box, so you can speak instead of type. The keyboard stays out of the way until you want it.
Six new subjects: hearing someone without fixing, letting an idea land, different political views, holding two parts of yourself, a kinder mirror, and turning toward a feeling instead of going numb.
Sixteen more scenarios in the first four subjects.
The role-play shows the other person's line before you choose your reply.
Your ideas are counted on the home screen.
Text starts smaller; change it in Settings.
The About page now says plainly where your data is backed up: only by your phone's own backup.
A gentle daily reminder to practise, at a time you choose, skipped on days you have already practised.
A settings page: reminders, light or dark pages, a theme colour, and text size.
Progress now shows how you rate yourself on each part of the rubrics, lately and before.
The today's practice card is easier to read in dark mode.
Daily practice: brainstorm reframes and phrases, compare with suggestions, rate yourself, and role-play your favourite.
Four subjects with eight scenarios each: letting go of being right, confusion as a signal, noticing the feeling, and when to push back.
Daily reflection on the last 24 hours, with a progress chart over two or twelve weeks.
Streaks, idea counts, and an about page with this version history.
